purpose: Determine whether a separately registered corrected-auditor pair could possibly qualify under conservative retained-cost floors before permitting any new measurement

retention.originalExperiment: Permanently failed; no resume, completion amendment, alternate-output replacement, or reinterpretation of the diagnostic replay as successful publication
retention.originalCharges: Keep the entire 24420-second and 13019119616-byte declared pair allowance, including the unused placement allowance
retention.originalNativeReceipt: Incomplete study with a completed native worker and successful native reconstruction; retain measuredSeconds and observedBytes as conservative ceilings on a future baseline native-cost denominator, never as a completed cost receipt
retention.failedAuditCosts: Retain the failed native and independent audit process receipts and logs for accounting. There is no completed audit/publication phase or closeout; do not invent one or use a partial audit as a completed denominator

recoveryPairRequirements.precondition: The necessary gate must pass before any recovery preparation, baseline, candidate or timing measurement is authorized
recoveryPairRequirements.newRegistration: A new explicitly versioned registration and one fixed new output are required; this protocol does not unlock the original runner or start a pair
recoveryPairRequirements.unchangedPhysicalAndLiteralContract: All context, actor, slot, reference, content, runtime/PDB, synthetic value, evaluator, owner, audit and retention requirements from the pinned original plan remain binding
recoveryPairRequirements.failedOrIncompleteRecovery: Retain and stop; no replacement, timing retry or qualification

prospectiveCostRule.phaseSources: Both recovery studies must complete. Read native costs from completion and audit/publication costs from final closeout without reducing completion costs
prospectiveCostRule.nativeBaselineDenominator: For nativeSeconds and nativeBytes separately, use min(first failed baseline native receipt anchor, completed recovery baseline phase cost). A slower recovery baseline cannot make the native ratio smaller
prospectiveCostRule.auditBaselineDenominator: Use the first completed corrected-auditor recovery baseline audit/publication phase. The original failed audit has no completed denominator and remains charged and retained
prospectiveCostRule.placementNumerator: For every phase use max(original retained placement phase cost, completed recovery placement phase cost). Preserve the original final-closeout audit/publication costs
prospectiveCostRule.ratios: max(1, placement numerator / baseline denominator), separately for each native and audit time/storage partition
prospectiveCostRule.forecast: Preserve completed-pilot scaling to 21888 fights, margin two, inherited floors, storage-before-audit scaling and the 120-second publication reserve
prospectiveCostRule.normalization: None. No per-actor, per-slot, per-report, path-length or other retrospective normalization

necessaryGate.nativeMinimumRatios: max(1, original placement native cost / first failed native receipt anchor)
necessaryGate.auditMinimumRatios: One for both audit phases is a mathematical lower bound, not an observed cost or assumed equality
necessaryGate.monotonicity: Any permitted future numerator is at least the original placement cost; any native denominator is at most the retained anchor; all audit ratios are at least one. The complete forecast is monotone in these ratios, including storage-driven audit scaling
necessaryGate.failureRule: If any rounded necessary phase floor is greater than or equal to its frozen partition cap, reject recovery before execution. A new measurement cannot lower that bound under this protocol
necessaryGate.successRule: A passing necessary gate alone grants no admission or runtime qualification; a separately registered completed matched pair and guarded current-runtime qualification remain required
necessaryGate.interpretation: A protocol-specific necessary resource bound only; not a current-runtime forecast, causal overhead estimate, scientific failure or efficacy result

notPermitted: Changing the original experiment, failure receipts, cost formula or evidence
Borrowing unused native time for audit/publication
Rounding down, reducing inherited floors, choosing a faster timing sample or enlarging resource limits
Running a recovery pair after a failed necessary gate
Native preparation, production entropy, scientific reservation or combat in this read-only gate
